explanation: Compared against erdosproblems.com/789: is h(n) = Θ(√n)? Straus gives the upper bound and the lower bound is open, so this is correctly tagged open. h(n) (subsetSumThreshold) is the maximal m such that every n-set A ⊆ ℤ has B ⊆ A, |B| ≥ m, in which equal sums of nonempty subsets force equal cardinalities. The distinct-elements reading is consistent with Erdős's random-α construction, which would fail with repetition. Faithful.
